You'll own the modelling and analysis roadmap for the FX product and turn rigorous statistical and machine learning work into better trading, product and commercial decisions. - Own and drive the technical direction and modelling roadmap for the FX product, identifying high-impact opportunities and prioritising work in collaboration with Product Managers. - Develop and productionise models to forecast and monitor FX rate volatility, providing actionable insights to support trading and execution strategy. - Apply statistical and machine learning models to optimise FX trade execution, focusing on minimising cost, improving routing efficiency and managing market risk exposure. - Establish robust backtesting, validation, monitoring and governance practices for financial-market models. - Partner with Product Managers, Traders, Risk, Engineering and other stakeholders to translate analytical findings into trading and product decisions. - Define success metrics and evaluate the incremental impact of models and strategies in production. - Move quickly from analysis to decision-ready recommendations, communicating clearly with executives and cross-functional partners—even when the data or problem is ambiguous. - Conduct customer and commercial analysis where it directly informs FX strategy, pricing or product priorities. You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ESSENTIALS - 7+ years of industry experience and an advanced degree, such as a PhD or MS, in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, Computer Science or Economics. - Significant experience applying statistics, machine learning or optimisation to financial markets, trading, fintech or other dynamic decision systems. - Strong understanding of FX, execution, pricing, liquidity, market risk or related quantitative domains. - Expert Python skills and strong SQL skills; experience with R or other quantitative tools is a plus. - Strong foundations in time-series modelling, statistical inference, optimisation and experimental design. - Ability to do schema design and dimensional data modelling, taking models from research/prototyping into reliable production systems. - Proven ability to set direction, influence and communicate with senior stakeholders and deliver through cross-functional teams. PREFERRED - Experience in technology, financial services, a trading environment and/or a high-growth environment. YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. - You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway. - You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details. - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. - You can advocate hard for a position, then fully support the team's direction once a call is made. LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM Data Science at Airwallex is evolving from individual analyses and standalone models into scalable systems of decision and action. We bring together two complementary capabilities: DS Analytics, which improves decision quality and reduces decision latency, and DS Algorithm, which directly optimizes product and business outcomes in real time. You’ll build systems of decision that help teams understand what changed, determine what to do next, and learn whether the action worked. This means owning the AI analytics harness around the analysis—including semantic layers, context retrieval, evaluation infrastructure, validation gates, and governance—so decisions remain reliable, contextualized, and trustworthy at scale. You’ll also build systems of action that use machine learning and AI to shape product behavior, ranking, pricing, risk, allocation, and customer experiences. As AI makes ad hoc analysis increasingly accessible, the remaining advantage is scale, scientific method, and rigor. You’ll structure ambiguous problems, design experiments, identify confounding factors, challenge misleading conclusions, and build production systems that produce reliable outcomes repeatedly—not just one-off answers. The work is moving up the stack: from analysis to system, from model to harness, and from answering a question once to building something that answers it correctly over time. If you want to create data science systems that compound decision quality and turn intelligence into measurable action, this is where that work happens. jobs.description_text:
About Arize

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace, so teams can ship faster with confidence.

Arize serves a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like Booking.com, Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an AI Application Engineer who thrives on solving hard problems with code. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work at the cutting edge of generative AI in a high-impact role with autonomy and ownership. While we are a remote-first company, the nature of this role requires candidates to be based in the Singapore area.

What You’ll Do

  • Debug and fix issues in our platform (and ship PRs with your fixes).
  • Build internal tools and copilots powered by generative AI to supercharge our team.
  • Rapidly prototype proof-of-concepts for customer use cases.
  • Work across Engineering, Product, and Solutions to unblock customers and push the boundaries of AI adoption.

What We’re Looking For

  • You have 2-5 years of experience in software.
  • Strong in Python and Golang; comfortable shipping fixes in production systems.
  • Hands-on with generative AI (LLM APIs, frameworks, building copilots or automations)
  • Hands-on with OpenTelemetry and deep familiarity with distributed tracing concepts.
  • Familiarity with AI frameworks (CrewAI, Langchain, Langgraph, DiFy, LiteLLM, etc).
  • Familiarity or eagerness to learn JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Great debugger, creative problem solver, and fast learner.
  • Independent and resourceful. You create solutions, not dependencies.

Bonus Points (but not required!)

  • Experience in a customer-facing role
  • Built copilots, plugins, or custom GenAI-powered applications.
  • Open-sourced or contributed PRs to real codebases.
  • Startup or fast-moving environment experience.

Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Arize is committed to offering competitive and locally compliant compensation and benefits packages for employees outside the United States. Benefits, employment terms, and statutory offerings vary by country and will be shared during the hiring process based on the location of the role. Eligibility for specific programs and benefits is determined by local laws, market practices, and employment arrangements.

More About Arize

Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.

Learn more about what we're doing here:

https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/20/arize-ai-hopes-it-has-first-mover-advantage-in-ai-observability/

https://arize.com/blog/arize-ai-raises-70m-series-c-to-build-the-gold-standard-for-ai-evaluation-observability/

Diversity & Inclusion @ Arize

Our company's mission is to make AI work and make AI work for the people, we hope to make an impact in bias industry-wide and that's a big motivator for people who work here. We actively hope that individuals contribute to a good culture

  • Regularly have chats with industry experts, researchers, and ethicists across the ecosystem to advance the use of responsible AI
  • Culturally conscious events such as LGBTQ trivia during pride month
  • We have an active Lady Arizers subgroup

Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

The Know Your Customer Technology Team at Binance is dedicated to building a state-of-the-art platform that ensures a seamless onboarding experience for our customers. Our focus is on developing a large-scale KYC platform, launching innovative products, and integrating regional and global compliance vendors.
